title: celtis aculeata var. laevigata
intro: Celtis aculeata var. laevigata, commonly known as the nettle tree or Indian nettle tree, is a plant species in the family Cannabaceae. The health benefits of Celtis aculeata var. laevigata include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic, which can help to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Celtis aculeata var. laevigata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
